insight: Built by YC W23 startup BerriAI; used in production by Netflix, Adobe, and Stripe, with 45k+ GitHub stars.
name: LiteLLM
tagline: AI gateway: call many LLMs through one OpenAI-format interface.
description: Open-source Python SDK and proxy server (AI gateway) that exposes 100+ LLM providers through a single OpenAI-compatible API, with cost tracking, load balancing, fallbacks, caching, and guardrails. Self-host the proxy or use the managed cloud; a paid Enterprise tier adds SSO, audit logs, and support.

modelSupport.notes: Unifies 100+ providers behind one OpenAI-format interface.

edge: Translates 100+ providers into one OpenAI-format call — so many other AI tools quietly embed it as their routing layer.
pros: Load balancing and guardrails built in
